analysis: Examined base text of EngineV2Bridge+Submission.swift (lines 1-991) and the only change: head lines 249-250 add `stopStringScope: stopStringScope` to the EngineV2Translation.cbv2Request call. stopStringScope is a bridge property not visible in this unit; its definition, its source, and how cbv2Request uses it are outside the supplied evidence. Because the parameter feeds request translation, it may affect stop-string matching (cbv2Request.stopStrings, passed to runPump at base line 937) or cache identity. checkpointScope is derived from cbv2Request.checkpointCacheSalt at base line 253, after translation, and that salt is the input to the hybrid checkpoint ready receipt (lines 351-352). Integration must confirm that EngineV2Translation does not fold stopStringScope into cacheSalt or checkpointCacheSalt in a way that weakens or replaces the coordinator-authored account scoping (T-041 mitigation (d), SEC-035), for example by mixing in caller-controlled input or creating cross-scope collisions. Integration must also confirm it does not alter output stop handling in a way that leaks content (A-001, T-008). No other control flow changed. Deadline checks, reservation release, and the cacheEnabled/multimodal gating are unchanged. No regression is identified from the visible code.
